videos.title: Blacksmithing - Getting Started: The Threaded Tenon. CBA Level I.
videos.desc:
The last in a series of the simple round tenon. The threaded tenon can be utilized as a clamp, useful for projects such as railing. The threaded tenon can also be utilized in repair work of traditional joined projects, and for the internal working of larger projects where the fame is already made.
This video is part of a community effort to move blacksmith education online during the COVID-19 pand

A look at basic forged round tenons, with some simple tooling and/or work-arounds that you can use as you get started.
You'll need to watch my Forging a Ball, Simple Guillotine and forging a Monkey Tool videos for this to make sense.
This video is part of an online effort by blacksmith to move our education online during this period of COVID-19 pandemic. Stay healthy.

#helpingannalisa, A monkey tool is used to dress the shoulder of a forged tenon. This video shows the monkey tool being made as well as the eye drift, and talks about the required slot punch.
Monkey tools are not used to dress the tenon, just the shoulder of the tenon.
This video is part of a community effort to move blacksmith education online during the COVID-19 pandemic.
